subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five memory role names, per-agent inheritance semantics, and the proposed legacy `memory` compatibility window as durable public config and Plugin SDK contracts?
rationale: The Gateway compatibility defect is mechanically repairable, but only maintainers can choose the permanent public taxonomy, decide whether roles without complete invocation protocols should ship now, and own the deprecation window.

options.title: Adopt all five roles
options.body: Keep the full role set and per-agent overrides, preserve legacy recall semantics everywhere, and document a named compatibility and deprecation window.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Ship only roles with complete current invocation behavior and defer dreaming or user-model selectors until their protocols are defined.

options.title: Wait for generic slot ownership
options.body: Pause this PR until a generic plugin slot-owner contract replaces memory-specific public surfaces.

recommendation.title: Adopt all five roles
recommendation.body: Keep the full role set and per-agent overrides, preserve legacy recall semantics everywhere, and document a named compatibility and deprecation window.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to public plugin SDK and Gateway contracts, and the canonical issue requires a project-level product/API decision.
